newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian evacuees from Albania back in Cairo.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian evacuees from Albania back in Cairo.

text.p: A group of 77 Egyptians who fled Albania amid machinegun fire has reached Cairo and efforts are underway to evacuate about 400 others, airport sources said on Monday.
They said the 77, mostly women and children, arrived on Sunday from Athens. The Greek navy had evacuated hundreds of civilians from the Albanian port of Durres.
"We reached Durres as Albanians shot at us, which prompted the Greeks to shoot back," said Mona Othman, the wife of an Egyptian who was working in Tirana.

"I was taking my wife and children to the port, planning to return another day when the Albanians started shooting, forcing me to accompany them to the boat. I left everything behind," said employee Hossam Badr el-Din.
Unrest erupted across southern Albania in January over the collapse of fraudulent pyramid investment schemes. It spread to most of the country in recent weeks.
